targets.descriptor: The sequin work is organised as a mapped geometric layout rather than an even scatter: broad matte self-fabric bands read as negative space between densely sequinned zones, so the motif appears as outlined rectangles and stepped bars across the bust and upper sleeves, resolving into stacked chevrons that point downward through the hip and lower skirt, with long vertical bars framing the centre front. Sequinned areas and matte bands alternate in the same tonal range, so the design reads mainly as a shift in light-return rather than a colour change, and the sequin discs sit in horizontal rows that catch light in visible strips. The sleeves carry the same banding continuing without interruption across the shoulder seam into the bodice, and the sleeve ends finish flush at the wrist with the sequin rows running to the very edge. The lower edge is a plain straight cut with no visible band or facing, and the surface between motifs appears to be a fine skin-tone ground through which the sequin lines are stitched.
